article.story: EVANSVILLE, Ind. -- — Tajianna Roberts scored 20 points, hitting a career-high six 3-pointers, to help No. 7 Louisville rout Southern Indiana 80-57 on Sunday. Imari Berry added 19 points, Zamareya Jones had 13 and Ariyana Cradle added 12 for the Cardinals (3-0). The Cardinals used a 10-0 run in the first quarter to build a 22-15 lead after the opening 10 minutes. Another 10-0 run in the second quarter, capped by Roberts' third 3-pointer fo the game extended the advantage. Berry hit a 3-pointer just before the halftime buzzer to give the Cardinals a 42-27 lead at the break. Louisville put the game away in the third quarter, hitting five 3-pointers, including three by Berry to push the advantage to 68-39 heading into the final quarter. Channah Gannon and Sophia Loden each scored nine points to lead Southern Indiana (0-3). Up next Louisville: hosts Lindenwood on Tuesday. Southern Indiana: The Screaming Eagles host Spalding on Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here
